articles.title: Zbigniew Ziobro: Polens Ex-Justizminister flieht nach Machtwechsel in Ungarn in die USA
articles.teaser: Nach dem Machtwechsel in Ungarn ist Zbigniew Ziobro in die USA ausgereist. In Polen wird der unter Korruptionsverdacht stehende PiS-Politiker per Haftbefehl gesucht.
articles.image_title: Zbigniew Ziobro: Picture taken on November 11, 2022 in Warsaw, Poland, shows then Polish Justice Minister Zbigniew Ziobro during an Independence Day march organised by nationalist groups. Ziobro, who faces criminal charges including misappropriating funds meant for crime victims to illegally purchase Israeli spyware, said on January 12, 2026 he had received "asylum" in Hungary. Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto confirmed Budapest had granted "asylum or refugee status to individuals suffering political persecution in Poland", without naming the individuals concerned. Polish conservative former justice minister Zbigniew Ziobro served from 2015 to 2023 in the government of the populist-nationalist Law and Justice (PiS) party, a close ally of Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban.
